methodology.description: Experimental candidate methodology — reference ranges calibrated against grid-wide dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e where sufficient data existed (5 of 15 ranges); everything else (weights, tunables, remaining ranges) inherited unchanged from mimir-f1-v1. NOT for production use — see productionReady.

teammateAdjustedQualifyingPace.description: % gap of representative qualifying lap time vs teammate (negative = faster).

teammateAdjustedCleanRacePace.description: % gap of average clean-lap race pace vs teammate on comparable stints. [v2-candidate: calibrated from dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e, algorithm: P2.5-P97.5 robust window, +10% padding, symmetric around 0 (signed delta, median close to 0)]

peakRepresentativePace.description: % gap of best sustained-stint average pace vs teammate (never a single fastest lap). [v2-candidate: calibrated from dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e, algorithm: P2.5-P97.5 robust window, +10% padding, symmetric around 0 (signed delta, median close to 0)]

qualifyingHeadToHead.description: % of comparable qualifying sessions won directly against the teammate.

cleanRaceLapConsistency.description: Coefficient of variation (%) of clean race laps within a single stint (never pooled across stints/compounds — see engine/cleanRaceLapConsistency.ts for why that matters). [v2-candidate: calibrated from dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e, algorithm: P2.5-P97.5 robust window, +10% padding]

cleanWeekendRate.description: % of rounds with no driver-attributable incident and no driver-attributable DNF.

driverAttributableReliability.description: % of starts without a driver-attributable DNF (technical DNFs excluded from the penalty).

qualifyingConsistency.description: Coefficient of variation (%) of valid qualifying laps within the same segment.

resultRelativeToExpectedPace.description: Average (expectedFinishPosition − actualFinishPosition); positive = beat pace-based expectation.

tyreStintManagement.description: PROXY, not raw tyre wear: teammate-relative clean-lap pace-evolution delta (ms/lap) on comparable stints (driverSlope − teammateSlope). Negative = driver's pace evolved more favorably than teammate's on a matched stint — scored as better.

startAndOpeningLapExecution.description: Average positions gained/lost from grid to end of lap 1, penalized for attributable contact.

racecraftProxy.description: Average net position change during green-flag racing, excluding lap 1 and pit-stop laps. v1 limitation: this is a position-delta proxy, not a true overtake/defend count — it cannot distinguish a strategy-driven position change from an on-track battle. [v2-candidate: calibrated from dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e, algorithm: P2.5-P97.5 robust window, +10% padding, symmetric around 0 (signed delta, median close to 0)]

changingConditionAdaptability.description: % teammate pace gap computed only across wet/mixed-condition rounds (normalized separately from dry). [v2-candidate: calibrated from dataset mimir-f1-2025-grid-f5952823620e, algorithm: P5-P95 robust window, +10% padding, symmetric around 0 (signed delta, median close to 0)]

documentedStrategicExecution.description: v1 has no objective telemetry proxy for strategic execution — this sub-component always reports missing raw data and is reweighted away unless a manual review adjustment (category "strategic_intervention") is recorded for the round.
